findings.title: Residual discovery fallback cannot deliver unsampled offers
findings.description: T13 permits restricting discovery to store-recorded samples if no discovery API exists. Those results are already sampled, so excluding sampled references leaves no offers. Current `MetrologyStore` lists samples; capture resolves a supplied target rather than enumerating unsampled results. Explicitly task candidate discovery instead of allowing this fallback. Otherwise the non-empty residual-offer guarantee and continued evidence accumulation cannot be delivered.

findings.title: Direction precedence contradicts its required outcome
findings.description: T7 says to implement the listed precedence exactly, starting with unconditional below-floor refusal, then requires below-floor low-agreement cells to reach `TIGHTEN`. Both cannot hold. Replace the contradictory sequence with an unambiguous decision table preserving floor-gated loosening and non-floor-gated tightening.

findings.title: Runtime-drawn-model warning is missing
findings.description: T9 requires the config-time model/threshold pairing note but omits the explicit warning that runtime-drawn models cannot have model-specific thresholds. T10/T16 check only note presence. Add the required warning to every recommendation and assert its content in text and JSON output, satisfying the slice’s fourth functional criterion.

findings.title: Malformed threshold handling is claimed but not tasked
findings.description: The coverage check claims malformed `judge:` blocks are exercised in T8, but T8 covers only registered and missing templates. Moreover, current `resolve_thresholds` directly converts values with `float()`; non-numeric values raise rather than provide the claimed inherited handling. Add an explicit handling decision and regression test providing the design’s warning and flagged target without modifying 300’s judging path.

findings.title: Lapse diagnostics lack a settled interface
findings.description: T13 fixes the return type as `list[OfferTarget]` while requiring distinguishable lapse information through an unspecified alternative mechanism. An empty list cannot distinguish exhaustion from lapse, and `find_graduation` alone does not establish current configuration state. Define the diagnostic contract before T13/T14 so T15 can consume it without redesigning earlier work.

findings.title: Commit placement and task splitting are excessive
findings.description: The pattern continues throughout: every implementation and test task receives its own commit marker, placing implementation commits before their regression tests. Merge small implementation/test pairs—particularly models and config keys—and retain markers only after tested working increments. Tests already immediately follow implementations; preserve that sequencing.

structured_findings.summary: Residual discovery fallback cannot deliver unsampled offers
Direction precedence contradicts its required outcome
Malformed threshold handling is claimed but not tasked
Lapse diagnostics lack a settled interface
Commit placement and task splitting are excessive
